support.faq1Q: What are the core active ingredients in M-CORE and where do they originate?
support.faq1A: M-CORE features a premium blend of global botanical extracts. The core active is Liboost® Damiana Extract (raw botanical from Mexico, extracted via a patented process in Spain). This is synergistically combined with Malaysian Tongkat Ali Extract (1:100 concentration), Peruvian Maca Extract, Tibetan Cordyceps Sinensis Extract, Brazilian Guarana Extract, Northern European Bilberry Extract, and essential nutrients like Zinc Gluconate and Vitamin B6.
support.faq2Q: How should I consume M-CORE and what are the storage requirements?
support.faq2A: According to product specifications, the recommended dosage is to take 2 tablets per day. For optimal shelf-life and potency, store M-CORE at room temperature (< 25°C) in a dry place. Keep the product sheltered from direct sunlight, moisture, or heat sources.
support.faq3Q: Are there any precautions or age restrictions for taking M-CORE?
support.faq3A: Yes. M-CORE is formulated strictly for adult vitality maintenance and is not suitable for individuals under 18 years old. Due to insufficient clinical data for certain demographics, pregnant women and lactating mothers should avoid use. If you are currently on prescribed medical treatment, please consult with your physician or dietician before consumption.
support.faq4Q: How long does it take to see noticeable results?
support.faq4A: Individual responses may vary depending on personal physical and stress conditions; some may observe positive changes within 1 to 2 weeks, while others notice differences within 1 to 2 months. However, clinical tracing for our premium ingredient, Liboost®, demonstrates statistically significant improvements in localized nitric oxide (NO) release, erectile metrics, and libido arousal within a structured 4-week (1 month) follow-up timeline.
support.faq5Q: Is M-CORE safe and free from pharmaceutical adulteration or doping substances?
support.faq5A: Absolutely. While dietary supplements for sexual enhancement frequently face chemical adulteration risks globally, M-CORE strictly enforces rigid quality control. Every batch of our premium Liboost® extract undergoes robust High-Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC) testing to ensure homogeneity and guarantees a 100% sildenafil-free (Viagra-free) formulation. It is free from banned substances, heavy chemical stimulants, and complies safely with modern athletic and clean-label standards.
